description: Check the status of a background Docker image pull started by local_ydb_pull_image. For known jobs it returns a monotonic progressPercent based on completed known Docker layers rather than bytes: 0-99 while running, 100 after successful completion, and the last observed value after failure.

jobId.description: Background pull job id returned by local_ydb_pull_image.

name: local_ydb_pull_status
